topic: Wave-7 dispatch forensics: fix validation under load, provider economics, and struggle taxonomy
notes:
Transcript-forensics record of the 2026-06-09/10 wave-7 fan-out (4 providers × 4 axes × self-created worktrees, serialized CLOSEOUT-beta folds; beta 7f0bad8→8b3dc19). Sources: harness session snapshots (~/.bro-harness/sessions/{faef2ed8,d341f326,24743606,d98ee38a}), live narrations, orchestrator IDE diagnostics. Operator question prompts: (1) glm websearch episode; (2) where agents spend time/struggle.

== HARNESS-FIX VALIDATION UNDER REAL LOAD (the headline) ==
- Compactions: ZERO across all four sessions (97-185min, up to 635 retained items) — 318cfec/318fcef window fix held; prior waves compacted routinely with false-memory risk.
- Manifest gating: brodex session shows 4 developer manifest items over 118 turns — each a genuine tool_search-driven manifest change (hash-gate working) vs per-turn delivery before 7f0bad8.

== GLM WEBSEARCH ROOT-CAUSE (answers "what precipitated the prohibition") ==
Session d98ee38a item 182: model says "Now emit the done note", then IN ONE assistant turn emits 6× server_tool_use web_search_prime {search_query:"test"} (Z.ai SERVER-SIDE builtin, executed mid-stream, never requested by harness) interleaved with model-written markdown mimicking a tool-execution UI; items 183-185 show it then finding the correct path (code-mode exec → note() → "note emitted"). Diagnosis: tool-confusion at the bbox_note emission point (note lives behind the code_mode exec surface), degenerate fallthrough into the provider's builtin grammar. Orchestrator's later "don't websearch" instruction was symptom-treatment. Filed gap-c21e34a3 (builtin suppression knob + exec-note discoverability).

== STRUGGLE TAXONOMY (time sinks ranked) ==
1. Cold worktree builds: every bro paid a full-workspace cold compile (×4 concurrently → host CPU saturation); multiple 600s timeout-kills; W7a's workspace check never fit the window. Known accepted cost of worktree isolation; quantified now.
2. Timeout orphan-reaping loops: timed-out cargo leaves sccache/rustc children holding the target lock; W7a ran three multi-turn pgrep/kill forensic loops. Filed gap-43059df9 (kill process group on timeout).
3. Launch-cwd file-tool trap: W7c silently edited 5 files in primary (caught via IDE diagnostics → bro_steer recovery: copy-to-worktree + checkout-- restore, executed flawlessly); W7b same trap + accidental primary commit, self-recovered; W7a dodged only because the shell layer rejects ../ escapes loudly. Filed earlier as gap-16d79781.
4. Provider outage: glm overloaded_error killed W7d at 116m mid-build; resume redid the build (~25min lost incl. re-build).
5. rtk wrapper friction (recurring, minor): rg unavailable, terse/swallowed output forcing rerun "in an explicit shell", `--` parsing trips. Not gap-filed (host tooling, operator-owned).

== PROVIDER ECONOMICS (wave 7, n=1 each, identical discipline) ==
- brodex gpt-5.5 high fast: 118 turns/97m work phase; call mix 43 shell_run/32 poll/26 exec; heavy code-mode user; meticulous orphan hygiene; root-cause quality high (corrected the gap's own diagnosis).
- deepseek-v4-pro: 112 turns/118m; chunky reads (14 file_read), 61 shell_run; self-recovered from cwd trap; clean rebase closeout.
- minimax M3: 298 turns/185m (~37s/turn — slowest lane); micro-step style (136 shell_run, 56 small file_reads, 67 polls); flawless steer compliance + best-documented field-parity report.
- glm-5.1: ~64+29+20 turns across outage+resume+closeout; sharp API archaeology (tokio histogram builder gating) and correct isolated-daemon smoke; one builtin-flail episode.
All four delivered review-grade work; zero quality rejections this wave (vs wave-1/4 steering rounds).

== CLOSEOUT DOGFOOD ==
Four serialized CLOSEOUT-beta.md executions by the bros themselves: 4/4 clean (1 no-op rebase, 3 real rebases incl. one with prior-fold neighbors; all ff-only merges + pushes + worktree/branch cleanup; one stale-target-dir needed manual rm after worktree remove already untracked it (glm W7d) — cosmetic). Serialization via orchestrator-sequenced resumes prevented branch-ref races by construction.

== RETRO DECISION ==
Skipped additional self-retros this wave: session transcripts answered every operator question directly (websearch, time sinks, struggles) and the one remaining fix shape (process-group reaping) was fully specified by the W7a narration. Retro cost exceeded marginal info; the wave-6 deepseek retro remains the template when transcripts are insufficient.

DISPATCH-PATTERNS PICKUP (2026-06-10 evening): worktree-cwd trap (gap-16d79781) re-grounded after a72a216. The original facet is CLOSED: worktree creation is host-owned (in-session creation fails closed) and dispatch project_dir flows --cwd → ToolCx.root (agent_loop.rs:633-640) — live-verified with a two-probe pair: project_dir probe resolved file tools in the worktree correctly; negative probe exposed TWO NEW FACETS of the same hazard class, now recorded on the gap: (1) bro_exec silently drops unknown params (cwd: vs project_dir: — no schema rejection; orchestrator misdispatch goes unnoticed), (2) project_dir omitted → harness root defaults to the DAEMON's cwd ($HOME under launchd) and a file-capable bro wrote into the operator's home directory. Fix shapes: deny_unknown_fields on dispatch param structs + cwd alias; fail-closed (or scratch-dir default) for file-capable dispatches without project_dir. Worktrees ts-w8/9/10 cleaned; probe worktree cleaned; stray $HOME marker removed.

WAVE 11 COMPLETE + DEPLOYED: tool-arg defaulting (design/bro-harness/tool-arg-defaulting.md steps 3-5) implemented by the new skinny-brodex brofile (brodex gpt-5.5 high priority, provider_defaults=explicit_only, two-sentence lens), beta head 29348cd, single restart carries 830c2c0+4dda50a+w11. LIVE-VERIFIED both directions: (1) my own misnamed bro_exec param (name: vs display_name:) was loudly rejected with the valid-field list by 4dda50a on the fresh binary — the hardening caught its author; (2) probe bro emitted bbox_note WITHOUT session_id → harness filled it from the host table, model saw defaults_applied rider, stored note carries session=ea421e6c. Bro's deliberate deviations (all accepted in review): dotted↔registered tool-name aliasing; pin matched-but-absent → pin_enforced rider without injection; BTreeMap order for glob match with exact-before-glob.

MID-RUN INCIDENT, FIXED: my monitoring bro_wait used timeout_secs (real param: timeout_seconds) — silently dropped pre-fix → unbounded wait, operator interrupted at 49m. Third silent-unknown-param hit in one day → 4dda50a extends deny_unknown_fields to all 48 bro param structs. Orchestrator memory updated with exact spelling.

SKINNY-BRODEX ECONOMICS (n=1, 247 turns / 96m38s ≈ 23.5s/turn): fresh input 406,953 ≈ 1.65K/turn (vs 7-12K wave-4 brodex pre-manifest-fix), output 33.7K, cached 28.3M. ZERO steering rounds, zero quality rejections; self-caught own test bug; reaped own orphaned grep sessions (gap-43059df9 lesson applied unprompted); sensibly escalated a 600s cargo cap to 900s when the daemon suite outgrew it (suite now genuinely ~610s — future briefs should say 900s for full-lib). Verdict: explicit_only + minimal lens costs nothing on quality for a well-specified brief and the fresh-token economics are the best measured on the Responses transport. Wall clock still ~60% cold-worktree cargo (no sccache in bro env — known lever, still unwired for dispatched shells).

Remaining on the defaulting design: pin population from fleet/workflow worktree creation (step 5 full form), cwd advertised-name flip with docs migration, broader ambient defaults (project/thread) pending the scope-semantics decision (§3.1).

ENV-UNIFY DEPLOYED + LIVE-VERIFIED (b5069cc, session "env-unify"): fleet.json project_dispatch now reaches every dispatched bro's shells. ROOT CAUSE was a latent misrouting: the fleet TUI merged project_dispatch into env_overrides, which for in-process harness providers becomes transport session_env — the lane shell children deliberately never inherit — so the documented RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache knob was a NO-OP for all bro cargo builds (w11's ~60%-cold-compile economics, mystery solved). FIX SHAPE: (1) new explicitly non-secret ToolCx::shell_env lane in bro-tools — applied to shell children after the credential scrub, before model per-call env (model wins; both directions tested); (2) harness plumb mirrors the w11 ladder (in-process arg > --shell-env > BRO_HARNESS_SHELL_ENV); (3) daemon resolves project_dispatch_shell_env(cwd) ONCE at the spawn choke point for every dispatch path — worktree cwds map to base repo via file-based .git gitdir parse (fail-closed; tested) — harness lane for in-process, child-process env for CLI providers; (4) TUI client-side merge retired; (5) new DAG-down dep blackbox→bro-fleet-client reuses FleetConfig load/lookup semantics incl. BLACKBOX_CONFIG. Validation: 395 crate + 1865/1865 lib + clippy 0. LIVE PROBE: cold-worktree bro echoed RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache and cargo check ok in 27s total; both host fleet.json copies already had the entry (knob configured all along, never delivered).

Remaining cycle-time levers from the assessment (unstarted): APFS-clone target seeding at worktree creation (the bigger lever — cold→incremental), cargo-nextest + slow-test quarantine (lib suite ~610s), RUSTY_V8_ARCHIVE shared cache if seeding doesn't absorb it, further root-crate splits (gap-fe4dd97f facility; root now 168.7k LOC/273 files — gap evidence corrected from stale 277k/422). Worktree ../ts-env-unify merged, removable.

TARGET SEEDING DEPLOYED + LIVE-VERIFIED (a0f03fc): fleet.json project_dispatch gains seed_dirs — repo-relative dirs CoW-cloned from base repo into freshly created worktrees, wired at BOTH mechanical creation sites (fleet cockpit dispatch + workflow WorktreeCreate, blocking pool). PROBE NUMBERS (premise validated before implementation): 56G target/ clones in 13.5s via APFS clonefile; seeded worktree cargo check = 31s with only 19 first-party units recompiled (workspace members are path-fingerprinted; all ~495 deps reuse); second check 0.39s. vs 10+min cold check / 25-40min cold test builds. Safety contract: path-escape keys refused, missing/present dirs skipped, --reflink=always (never plain copy — a multi-GB physical copy costs more than the cold build), partial clones removed. Validation: 143 crate + 49 workflow-ops + 1865/1865 lib + clippy 0. LIVE SMOKE per fleet-TUI convention (isolated tmux socket, real cockpit): dispatched agent's worktree carried the seeded 66G target and the agent itself reported `66G	target` from inside. Host fleet.json ×2 now carry seed_dirs:["target"]. Both binaries redeployed (blackboxd + bro CLI). Worktrees ts-env-unify/ts-target-seed/ts-w11 removed; peer's ts-w13 untouched.

CYCLE-TIME ARC SCORECARD (the "why do features take 1hr+" question): sccache now reaches every dispatched bro shell (env-unify b5069cc) + warm-target seeding at worktree creation (this) = the two dominant levers landed same-session. Expected dispatched-bro feature cycle: cold-build tax ~25-40min → ~1-2min (clone+incremental), leaving model time + the ~610s full-lib gate as the remaining costs. NEXT LEVERS (unstarted): cargo-nextest + slow-test quarantine for the lib suite; RUSTY_V8_ARCHIVE shared cache (likely subsumed by seeding); root-crate splits (gap-fe4dd97f). Convention-doc note: the fleet-dispatch-env convention entry mentions project_dispatch/project_closeout — seed_dirs extends that surface; propose updating the rendered convention text next time memories are reviewed.

RESOLVED — the forensics record answered the operator's questions (glm websearch root-cause, struggle taxonomy, provider economics) and every actionable finding has landed or been peeled. Struggle taxonomy disposition: (1) cold worktree builds → KILLED by env-unify b5069cc (sccache to all dispatched shells; the fleet.json knob had been silently misrouted to transport env since inception) + target-seed a0f03fc (CoW seeding: 56G target in 13.5s, cargo check 10+min→31s; live-verified through the cockpit); (2) timeout orphan-reaping → gap-43059df9 fixed (5b84b5c), bros now reap unprompted; (3) launch-cwd file-tool trap → gap-16d79781 fully closed across three facets (a72a216 host-owned worktrees + 830c2c0 cwd alias/deny-unknown/scratch-fail-closed + 4dda50a all-params hardening), each facet live-probed; (4) provider outage resilience → resume worked as designed; (5) rtk friction → host-tooling, operator-owned, not filed. The thread also hosted the follow-on dispatch-patterns arc: w11 tool-arg defaulting (skinny-brodex build, prod-verified ambient session default + riders), env-unify, target-seed, and the rendered fleet dispatch-env convention update (c46b67e8, committed + rendered). Residuals peeled to: thread-55d51135 (defaulting completion: pins, ambient expansion, cwd name flip), thread-9938dffd (build-cycle levers: nextest/quarantine, RUSTY_V8_ARCHIVE check, crate splits), thread-92160ddd (runbook distillation incl. the CHANGED sequential-vs-parallel calculus).
